class.name: NetwLifecycleRequest
class.brief_description: A controller's spawn, despawn or move of an entity, waiting for the server's verdict.
class.description: The server receives one in [signal NetwEntity.lifecycle_requested] for each change the [member NetwEntity.controller] of a [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER] entity makes, and can call [method deny] before other peers see it. [codeblock] func _on_lifecycle_requested(peer_id: int, request: NetwLifecycleRequest) -> void: if request.kind == NetwLifecycleRequest.KIND_DESPAWN and not may_remove(peer_id): request.deny("only the builder removes it") [/codeblock] Once denied, the request stays denied. The peer that made the change receives [signal NetwEntity.lifecycle_refused] with the [member reason].

method.name: deny
method.description: Refuses this change and records [param reason] for the peer that made it. Only the first call counts.

members.member: Whether the change is refused. Writing [code]false[/code] after [method deny] has no effect.
The parent the entity is placed under, or [code]null[/code] for [constant KIND_DESPAWN]. On a spawn [member entity] has not entered the tree yet, so read the world from here.
The entity the change is about. On a spawn it is the server's copy, holding the values the controller sent.
What the server passed to [method deny], empty until then.
The peer that made the change.

constants.constant: The controller spawned the entity with [method Netw.spawn], [method Netw.replicate] or [method NetwEntity.spawn_under].
The controller despawned the entity with [method Netw.despawn] or [method NetwEntity.despawn].
The controller moved the entity with [method Netw.reparent] or [method Node.reparent].
